description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the FeatureProperties interface, providing methods to create, access, modify, and serialize feature properties represented as JSON objects within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ImmutableFeatureProperties
classes.description: An immutable class implementing FeatureProperties, wrapping a JsonObject and providing methods to manipulate and retrieve feature property data.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns a new empty instance of FeatureProperties.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a FeatureProperties instance initialized with the provided JSON object, validating JSON keys.

methods.name: isBoolean, isNumber, isInt, isLong, isDouble, isString, isObject, isArray, isNull
methods.description: Type-check methods to determine the JSON value type.

methods.name: asBoolean, asInt, asLong, asDouble, asString, asObject, asArray
methods.description: Type-casting methods to retrieve the JSON value in the specified type.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Overloaded methods to set a value for a given key as various data types.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Set methods for JsonFieldDefinition and JsonField.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the properties.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key as an Optional.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves nested JsonObject(s) via JsonPointer, JsonFieldDefinition, or JsonFieldSelector.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key and its associated value.

methods.name: iterator, stream
methods.description: Iterate over or stream the contained JsonFields.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Serializes the object to the provided SerializationContext.

methods.name: getUpperBoundForStringSize
methods.description: Returns an estimate of the upper string size.
